title: Radiance

inlines.v: RA'DIANCE, RA'DIANCY, noun [Latin radians, radio, to beam or shoot rays. See Radius and Ray.] Properly, brightness shooting in rays or beams; hence in general, brilliant or sparkling luster; vivid brightness; as the radiance of the sun. The Son girt with omnipotence, with radiance crown'd of majesty divine.
